name: Sisera
summary: The captain of King Jabin's army, who oppressed Israel for twenty years with nine hundred iron chariots. The LORD routed his army before Barak, and Jael killed him in her tent.

key_moments.title: Oppresses Israel Twenty Years
key_moments.description: The LORD handed Israel over to Jabin, king of Canaan, whose army captain was Sisera. With nine hundred iron chariots, Sisera harshly oppressed Israel for twenty years.

key_moments.title: Routed at the Kishon
key_moments.description: Sisera gathered his chariots at the river Kishon to meet Barak. The LORD threw his army into panic, and Sisera jumped down from his chariot and fled on foot.

key_moments.title: Killed in Jael's Tent
key_moments.description: Sisera ran to Jael's tent, and she covered him and gave him milk to drink. While he slept she drove a tent nail into his head, and Barak found him dead.
